project_context.scope: Redesign ONLY the Projects listing page (/projects) for a premium real-estate website.
project_context.restrictions: Keep existing header, footer, homepage, project detail functionality, logo, typography style, and the black/orange/white color system. 19 projects exactly (13 completed, 6 ongoing). No external imagery needed (local assets used).

typography.rules: Preserve existing Clash Display style (or geometric equivalent) for headings and numbers. Uppercase heavily used for architectural feel.

hierarchy.page_title: text-5xl md:text-7xl uppercase tracking-tight leading-none text-[#F4F4F0]

directions_considered.name: Direction 1: The Interactive Editorial List
directions_considered.concept: Massive text-only rows. Hovering over a row reveals a floating cinematic video box attached to the cursor.
directions_considered.cons: Bad for mobile (touch devices don't have hover). Fails requirement to show standard photos.

directions_considered.name: Direction 2: The Cinematic Asymmetrical Grid (RECOMMENDED)
directions_considered.concept: Breaks the uniform 3-column grid into a 12-column masonry-style grid with tension. Projects alternate in emphasis (e.g., Hero size vs Supporting size).
directions_considered.pros: Accommodates videos beautifully, creates visual rhythm, scales perfectly to mobile as edge-to-edge full-bleed cards.

recommended_spec.page_container: max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 lg:px-12 pt-32 pb-48
recommended_spec.header_section: flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-8 mb-24 border-b border-[#F4F4F0]/10 pb-12

filters.pill: px-6 py-3 rounded-full border border-[#F4F4F0]/10 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center gap-2

card_rhythm: Loop this pattern for the remaining projects.

project_card.wrapper: group relative flex flex-col gap-6 cursor-pointer

media_slot.container: relative w-full overflow-hidden bg-black/20 border border-[#F4F4F0]/5
media_slot.aspect_ratios: Hero (12-col): aspect-[21/9] or aspect-[16/9]. Standard (5/7-col): aspect-[4/3] or aspect-[3/4]. Mobile: aspect-[4/5] edge-to-edge.
media_slot.image: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-[1.5s] ease-[cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)] group-hover:scale-105
media_slot.video_layer: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-700 z-10 pointer-events-none (Placeholder for <video> tags)
media_slot.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A]/80 via-transparent to-transparent z-20 md:opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500

metadata.number_badge: absolute -top-12 -left-4 md:-left-8 text-7xl md:text-9xl font-black text-[#F4F4F0]/[0.03] select-none pointer-events-none z-0
metadata.title: text-2xl md:text-4xl uppercase tracking-tight text-[#F4F4F0] group-hover:text-[#E85D22] transition-colors duration-300 z-10
metadata.type_location: text-sm text-[#F4F4F0]/60 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2

status_badge.completed: inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs tracking-widest text-[#F4F4F0]/80 border border-[#F4F4F0]/20 px-3 py-1
status_badge.ongoing: inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs tracking-widest text-[#E85D22] border border-[#E85D22]/30 bg-[#E85D22]/10 px-3 py-1

motion.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-up for header and filter pills (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration 0.8s).
motion.scroll_reveal: Cards enter viewport with subtle upward drift and blur reveal (y: 40, filter: 'blur(10px)', opacity: 0).
motion.filter_transition: Use <motion.div layout> for the grid so when 'Completed' or 'Ongoing' is selected, cards smoothly glide into their new grid positions.
motion.hover_state: Image scales up slowly (scale 1.05 over 1.5s). Metadata slides up slightly (y: -5px) to indicate clickability.

mobile_behavior.layout: Grid switches to 1 column. Edge-to-edge media (negative horizontal margins).
mobile_behavior.media: Instead of hover to play video, the video should trigger via IntersectionObserver when 50% in view.
mobile_behavior.filters: Horizontal scrollable flex row without scrollbars (overflow-x-auto, no-scrollbar).

accessibility.focus: Focus states MUST be high contrast. Use 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#E85D22] focus-visible:outline-none' on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-current='page' on active filters. Include aria-labels for projects.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure project metadata maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast against the #0A0A0A background.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT change the header, footer, or any other pages. Redesign ONLY the /projects listing area.
Enforce the specific data structure exactly: 19 projects (01-19), 13 Completed, 6 Ongoing.
Video tags should be added but empty/placeholder src for now, wired to show on hover (desktop) or scroll (mobile).
Use Framer Motion for the layout transitions when filtering the grid (layout prop is essential here).
Create depth through layering: the giant project numbers should sit BEHIND the project images visually.
Ensure the ember orange (#E85D22) is used sparingly as an accent for active states and hover intents to maintain the luxury feel.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers (though not strictly applicable as header shouldn't be touched).
